title: We Politely Insist: Your LLM Must Learn the Persian Art of Taarof

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to open-ended role-play scenarios involving Persian ritual politeness (taarof) using an LLM judge, and comparing performance between taarof-expected and non-taarof scenarios, as well as testing scenarios with and without explicit geographic context ('in Iran').

Testing model responses using 110 counterfactual scenario pairs that vary only by the gender designation of the user role (e.g., flipping genders or assigning gender to neutral roles) and evaluating both accuracy differences and the presence of gender stereotypes in the models' rationales.
Comparing model performance on the same set of scenarios prompted in English versus translated into Persian to determine if the language used acts as a cue for culturally appropriate reasoning.
